ns2:section.sectionText: For up-to-date information about statistics course registration, please see our registration update pages: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration This section is restricted to Statistics graduate students. Instructor approval is required for graduate students in other departments. Most seats are open to any statistics graduate student, but a few seats are reserved for statistics PhD students. If you receive a Reserve-Closed error, that means the course is full except for the reserved seats.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Statistics department.
